policies_payer_chk.name: policies_payer_chk
policies_payer_chk.value: ("policies"."category" = 'private' AND "policies"."insurer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "policies"."scheme_id" IS NULL) OR ("policies"."category" = 'government' AND "policies"."scheme_id" IS NOT NULL AND "policies"."insurer_id" IS NULL)

claims_dates_chk.name: claims_dates_chk
claims_dates_chk.value: "claims"."discharge_date" IS NULL OR "claims"."admission_date" IS NULL OR "claims"."discharge_date" >= "claims"."admission_date"

claims_amounts_chk.name: claims_amounts_chk
claims_amounts_chk.value: ("claims"."claimed_amount" IS NULL OR "claims"."claimed_amount" >= 0) AND ("claims"."approved_amount" IS NULL OR "claims"."approved_amount" >= 0)
